thread:
alex (SRE): quick follow-up from the midnight incident — recurring latency spikes on /generate. postmortem draft linked in #incidents, but we need concrete ownership/timelines for SLO changes and dashboards.

marie (Infra): saw the pattern too. looks like KV cache churn + a bad autoscale step. we should tighten the latency SLO window for p95 while we root cause. suggestion: change p95 target from 220ms -> 260ms for 2 weeks as a temporary safety valve. thoughts? @jonathan

jonathan (ProdEng): ok with a temporary relaxation if we also commit to a mitigation timeline. propose: short-term SLO tweak for 14 days, rollback once canary with increased cache TTL passes. owner: jonathan. ETA: 10 business days.

carmen (SRE): agree but add a dashboard panel showing error-budget burn rate and autoscale latency buckets. otherwise we'll miss regression signals. I can own dashboard work. ETA: 3 days.

alex (SRE): ownership summary so far: jonathan -> mitigation (10d), carmen -> dashboard (3d), marie -> infra rollback/scale policy review (5d). I'll own the SLO change PR and the announcement to partners.

marie (Infra): confirmed. I'll also add an alert for sudden kv cache eviction rate > 5% in 5m. That should catch recurrence earlier. ETA 48h.

jonathan (ProdEng): mitigation plan high-level: patch cache retention to prefer longer-lived prefixes, add warmup for new workers, and reduce scale-down aggressiveness. I'll post a short RFC this afternoon.

alex (SRE): for compliance: we need to record the SLO exception window and note it in the incident timeline. ops-bot, can you create a tracker card?

ops-bot: created ticket INF-1721 "SLO exception window + follow-ups" and linked to this thread — https://tracker.company/INF-1721 :white_check_mark:

carmen (SRE): quick dashboard note: panel names proposed — "/generate p95 (post-incident)", "Autoscale step latency buckets", "KV eviction rate". I'll add annotations for last 3 incidents.

alex (SRE): decision checklist: 1) Apply temporary SLO p95 bump for 14d (approved). 2) Add dashboard + alerts (carmen, 3d). 3) Infra policy review + alert (marie, 48h). 4) Mitigations RFC + patch (jonathan, 10d). 5) Close exception and revert SLO after verification (alex).

marie (Infra): can someone volunteer to run the canary warmup test next week? need a quick runbook.

jonathan (ProdEng): I will. I'll post runbook steps under INF-1721 by EOD.

alex (SRE): thanks all. I'll open the SLO PR now and add reviewers: @marie, @carmen. please drop quick ack when done. :thumbsup:

carmen (SRE): ack, will review PR today.

marie (Infra): ack, reviewing after standup.

alex (SRE): final note — recurring pattern flag: this is the third kv-related latency blip in 6 weeks. if we hit >2 incidents in a 30d window, we escalate to a hotfix-only cadence. adding that to the runbook.

jonathan (ProdEng): noted. putting a follow-up on the RFC to consider long-term fixes (sharded cache, admission throttling).

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: check-in in 3 days for dashboard + alert progress.

alex (SRE): keeping thread open for progress updates. will post SLO PR link once created.
